# Owned allocated constructor context fixture

A nullary constructor creates a generic collection subclass and an independent
context object before delegating to a complete nested class-formal List type
and a fixed nominal context. Source and SDK-provider profiles retain original
compiler entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions and compile every Java unit.
Frozen direct, separately compiled, reflection and method-handle callers run
96 fresh JVM cases twice. They observe allocation/evaluation order, fresh object
identities, partial final fields, constructor/callback effects, exact failures,
mutable list contents, nulls and delayed element casts. Six wrong programs and
six Signature-only controls protect the contract. Only owned fixture programs
execute. JDK 21 compiles originals; recovered constructor prologues use JDK 25.
